strengths: Deployed vision-guided pick-and-place on a physical arm (COFFIN): TensorRT YOLO 56.7->10.9 ms, visual servoing, 10/10 pick reliability, which is perception integrated with manipulation on hardware
Multi-camera frame capture in a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline, plus ToF range-gating that is a runtime sensor sanity check
BARC: ZoeDepth monocular depth for crack profiling at +/-8% error, plus homography stitching, which is real geometric vision and 3D reconstruction work
CARLA pipeline using semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to generate ~5,000 YOLO labels, which shows dataset construction and occlusion awareness
U-Net segmentation with Dice/IoU evaluation, and YOLOv8n at 83% mAP@50 on a held-out set, so basic eval discipline
real_gaps: No camera calibration (intrinsics/extrinsics, hand-eye) anywhere in the profile beyond sensor jitter tuning
No object 6-DoF pose estimation, point clouds, Open3D or PCL
No SLAM, multi-camera extrinsic fusion or depth-sensor fusion
No evidence of preventing evaluation leakage or building structured eval suites across lighting/viewpoint/occlusion shifts
Perception is mostly detection plus 2D servoing, not 3D scene understanding for grasping
Seniority note: role expects owning a system over time and mentoring; profile is capstone/internship scope
overstated_by_keywords: depth counted Have: it is monocular ZoeDepth on microscopy, not RGB-D or stereo for manipulation
robot manipulation perception counted Have: COFFIN is a 2-link arm with 2D YOLO servoing, not grasp pose or 3D
C++ and GPU optimization: real, but the role treats them as nice-to-have so they add little
understated_by_keywords: COFFIN's 11 resolved integration failures (stale-frame capture, false positives) show failure diagnosis on a physical robot, which the JD stresses
CARLA occlusion filtering and BARC homography work are closer to geometric vision than the Adjacent label suggests
screening_gaps: No camera calibration or hand-eye/coordinate-transform ownership
No 3D perception: object pose estimation, point clouds, Open3D/PCL
No evidence of owning a substantial perception system through to measured eval at production scope
llm_analysis.reasoning: The profile has real on-robot detection and depth work, but the core of this role, calibration, 3D geometry and pose estimation, has no backing. A recruiter filtering on those would likely pass, though the COFFIN vision-to-grasp story is a credible hook if you apply anyway.
